## What I Do

Sai Dutta Abhishek Dash builds at the intersection of three domains:

1. **Language AI for underserved markets** — Tokenizer optimization, LLMs, speech recognition, and translation for low-resource Indian languages. Building the first commercial Odia-specific AI API for 38 million speakers.
2. **On-device ML and edge security** — Sub-100KB inference models, phishing detection, and model quantization for production deployment on consumer hardware, routers, and lightweight VPS instances.
3. **Privacy-first infrastructure** — Zero-knowledge architectures, on-device processing, encrypted communication systems, and self-hosted platforms.

## Maelis Research

Maelis Research is a language AI venture founded in 2026, based in Dhenkanal, Odisha, building language AI infrastructure for Odia and other low-resource Indian languages.

**Why it exists:** 38 million people speak Odia. No commercial Odia-specific AI API existed before Maelis Research. For comparison, Norwegian (5M speakers), Greek (13M), and Dutch (25M) all have robust language AI support.

**What it is building:**

- **Odia-optimized tokenizer** — 3x more efficient than generic alternatives for Brahmic scripts
- **Lekhani** — Odia-exclusive LLM family in capability tiers (Pada, Chhanda, Kavya, Mahakavya)
- **Shruti** — Odia speech recognition and synthesis
- **Anuvada** — Odia translation with cultural context
- **odia-eval-benchmark** — 121,947 rows, 7 task families, 34 datasets, published on Hugging Face

All research released under Apache 2.0. DPIIT Startup Recognition. Positioned for IndiaAI Mission.
Website: https://maelis.sdad.pro · Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/MaelisResearch

## Key Products

All 22 systems below are original work and open source.

### AI & Language Infrastructure

- **ornith-flight** — Expert-streaming C99 inference engine for Ornith 35B MoE. Runs 20 GB models on 8 GB Apple Silicon via per-layer streaming I/O. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/ornith-flight)
- **AgentLoop** — Harness-agnostic, self-verifying autonomy wrapper for coding agents. Drives OpenCode/Kilo/Claude/Aider/Codex in a verify-gated loop with a held-out oracle. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/agentloop)
- **MarkItDownJS** — Universal document-to-Markdown conversion engine for TypeScript. Converts PDFs, Office docs, images, audio, and archives into AI-ready Markdown. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/MarkItDownJS)
- **PhishScout** — 131 KB on-device phishing URL detector. 90% precision, ~4ms per lookup. (https://huggingface.co/saidutta69/PhishScout)
- **Hinglish-Bench** — Reference-free benchmark for Hindi-English code-mixed text generation. 34 prompts, 8 categories, lm-evaluation-harness integration. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/hinglish-bench)

### Security & Systems

- **Vulscany** — Private, self-hostable AI code security agent with automated fix generation. Multi-language scanning, real-time CVE matching. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/vulscany)
- **PraharShield** — High-performance Minecraft Velocity anti-bot filter. CAPTCHA handshakes, client fingerprinting, blocks 100k join-flood JPS on a 1GB RAM VPS. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/PraharShield)
- **CL-Chat Reborn** — P2P command-line chat with X25519 ECDH encryption and ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/cl-chat-reborn)
- **Forensic-Recovery** — Forensically-sound digital evidence acquisition with SHA-256 chain-of-custody. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/Forensic-Recovery)
- **DadGuard** — Lightweight Windows security watchdog for non-technical users. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/DadGuard)

### Platforms & Products

- **Binify** — Zero-knowledge encrypted pastebin with client-side encryption. (https://bin.sdad.pro)
- **Ansora** — Self-hostable serverless blogging platform. Markdown + git, no database. (https://blog.sdad.pro)
- **The Watcher** — Stalks 13 Indian used-tech subreddits 24/7, LLM-extracts price/specs, drops rich Discord embeds. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/The-Watcher)
- **Visitor Analytics** — Privacy-preserving, framework-agnostic analytics SDK. Zero PII. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/visitor-analytics)
- **PacketBuddy** — Cross-platform network usage monitor with real-time analytics. (https://github.com/instax-dutta/packet-buddy)
- **Auralyn** — Discord music bot with integrated Lavalink, single-container Docker deployment. (https://auralyn.sdad.pro)
